adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no topic is found it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and `render 'loading'`; it never instantiates `TopicRetriever` or calls `retrieve` (see `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb`). However, `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` asserts `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve` is called when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` returns nil. That expectation is incompatible with the controller code and the spec would fail / test behavior that doesn’t exist, while also not asserting the actual enqueue+loading behavior.
